text:
elena_sales: Hey @matt_finance quick question I charged a client dinner last night to my personal card because the team needed to keep the meeting going. Total = $276.12 (includes a $45 tip). Receipt: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/1856012345-dinner.jpg

matt_finance: Thanks Elena. Two things: 1) if it was a group/client meal, we prefer corp card; 2) reimbursement policy handles meals up to per-diem limits or itemized business meals. Do you have an attendee list and indication this was business entertainment (client present)? Link: https://intranet.redwood.example/policies/expenses#meals

tara_ops: Travel ops confirms client dinner after the product demo, attendees: Elena, Sam (eng), Priya (PM), and Kai (client). It was business-related.

elena_sales: Attendees listed above. I used personal because corp card holder left early and we needed to run the meal. I attached the itemized receipt (shows food $187.12, alcohol $44.00, tip $45.00).

matt_finance: Policy: alcohol on client meals is reimbursable when client is present and manager approves; tips are reimbursable up to 20% unless a local law requires more. Also we need manager approval for amounts over $250.

shawn_mgr: Confirming this was client entertainment and I approve reimbursement. Approved for the full amount less any policy adjustments. :white_check_mark:

matt_finance: Thanks Shawn. We'll code the expense as Entertainment (GL 6550). Elena, please submit in Ramp: Expense type = Meals & Entertainment -> Client Meal, attach receipt, list attendees, select reimbursement to bank (we don't reimburse personal card back to card). For the charge breakdown, finance will: include food + allowable alcohol, cap tip at 20% of pre-tax food if needed.

elena_sales: Submitted RMP-25643. In comments I added attendees and requested ACH last4 2211.

ramp-bot: Expense RMP-25643 created and routed to Finance. Processing ETA: next payroll.

matt_finance: Validated docs. Note: invoice shows 20% tip = $37.42 cap; we'll process $271.70 (food 187.12 + alcohol 44.00 + tip capped 37.42 + tax adjustments). Final amount will reflect card currency conversion and posted bank amount. We'll notify when ACH is scheduled.

elena_sales: Appreciate it, thanks everyone. :pray:
